nodes.label: W-252 — the seven entries put through independent re-derivation
nodes.rationale: W-101 requires the subject matter proven, and an instrument that measures a claim and an entry that states it are the same act by the same hand.

nodes.label: Blind re-derivation with adversarial checkers
nodes.rationale: Each entry re-derived by a reader working from the volumes alone — barred from method/proofs, PHASE1-LEDGER.md, the W-texts, SETTLED-R4.tsv and the build instrument, which between them restate every conclusion — then put to three checkers on separate lenses: arithmetic, verbatim citation, and scope overreach. Twenty-eight readings; no entry withdrawn, four corrected.

nodes.label: Register 1849 — the word the ratio refutes
nodes.rationale: 2.5/2.4 = 1.0417, and a ratio above one means worse — outside by 4.17 %, not inside. The finding is untouched; one word falls.

nodes.label: Register 1850 — the biconditional's third printing
nodes.rationale: The table prints the claim contraposed on both sides, and ¬P ⟺ ¬Q is equivalent to P ⟺ Q — so a repair touching only the two named sites would have left it standing.

nodes.label: Register 1851 — a census of a string cannot see a restatement
nodes.rationale: 26/9 is 4ν/3 + 4/(9ν) at ν = 2, so the caption states the same approximation and the same error without printing the string the count was taken over.

nodes.label: Register 1852 — two operators called ℛ (later superseded)
nodes.rationale: The section that would disambiguate the operator, titled 'Two pairwise operators, and this book has used one name for both', is one of the nine empty headings — so the empty-sections finding and the bundling finding turn out to be the same fault. 1852 measured both readings and did not choose; it was itself wrong and is superseded by 1853.

nodes.label: A figure only its own instrument can produce is not yet proven
nodes.rationale: 1842's extent claim was independently confirmed and corroborated from an unexpected direction, but an independent harvest returned 613 and 325 against the printed 1,021 and 400 — a different claim-predicate, not a contradiction. Recorded rather than repaired.
